skill.displayName: Bikini Contest Photos – Create Contest-Ready Images Online – API-powered
skill.summary: Bikini contest photos — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the bikini-contest-photos-openapi-skill.
- Transforms a photo of a person into a bikini contest image or video.
- Requires HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai and a WESHOP_API_KEY.
- Provides endpoints to start a run, poll status, and upload images.
- Supports input customization, including output type (video/image), description, and batch count.
- Includes security reminders to safeguard your API key.
